pure-announcement.rationale: This documents the mechanism of an existing, standing feature, not a launch, release note, or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: Automatic prefix caching (RadixAttention) reuses KV-cache computation for shared prompt prefixes inside an inference engine; this note is about exact-match, full-response caching at a gateway/proxy layer keyed on provider+endpoint+model+auth+body — a reader of one learns nothing about the other.

unfalsifiable.rationale: It is Cloudflare's own documentation of its own product's mechanism, checkable directly against observed behavior (the cf-aig-cache-status header).

durability.rationale: The genuine mechanism — exact-match caching on the full request body, hashed with SHA-256 — is real, but roughly half the note is Cloudflare-specific procedure that will churn: dashboard click-paths, API token scopes, and named headers (cf-aig-skip-cache, cf-aig-cache-ttl, cf-aig-cache-key) rather than a vendor-independent pattern.

actionability.rationale: It changes a build decision that holds even off Cloudflare: response caching for LLM calls defaults to exact-match on the full request, so anything less than byte-identical input is a miss, and a caching layer needs an explicit override path (custom key, TTL, skip) to be useful for real traffic.

atomicity.rationale: One idea — default exact-match response caching keyed on the full request, with three per-request override mechanisms — states cleanly in a paragraph.
